entities.summary: The Somaliland National Army, is the land force and largest branch of the Somaliland Armed Forces is based in the Somaliland capital of Hargeisa. The Somaliland National Army is composed entirely of professionals and volunteers as the state does not mandate conscription. Some Somaliland battalions operate near the Puntland border due to a border dispute.
